title: 第11章 血炼诀还是太全面了第12章 你等等我成邪修了
slug: 凡人修仙捡个仙子做老婆
content_zh:
次奥！
周元惊出一身的冷汗，如果反应稍微慢那么片刻，这道血光怕是能贯穿胸口，当场要了他的命。
哪冒出来的牲口，不打招呼直接下死手？
周元周身雷光乱窜，刹那间暴起，冲向了前面山坡。可起身瞬间，谷口已经冲进来一道雄壮的身影，手掌狠狠拍击地面。
轰！
大地轰鸣，山谷摇颤，一股磅礴的血雾轰然炸开，如狂潮怒卷，席卷山谷，也淹没了周元。
“吼……”
血雾里竟似有恶兽咆哮，狠狠地撞到了周元身上。
周元只觉一股无法抗拒的巨力袭来，通体乱颤，离地飞了出去，落地之后接连翻腾，那感觉像是五脏六腑都错了位，张口喷出一股血水。
这是什么灵法？
竟然能震荡血气！
周元挣扎几下，一头栽倒地上，虚弱的身子实在经不起这种狂暴的冲击。他艰难抬起头，模糊的视线里，一个胸脯横阔，高大魁梧男人正从血雾里走出来。
“地鳞蟒……雷翼雕……都是一级巅峰妖兽。”
男子啧啧称奇，这里是云雾山脉的外围，寻常妖兽都罕见，竟然会有一级巅峰，而且还是两只。
更是不可思议的是，竟然同归于尽了。
这可是难得的奇遇啊。
男子看向了角落里的岩洞，里面很有可能藏着什么秘密，才引来了这两只一级巅峰的妖兽，还不惜打到死。
而这小子刚刚满脸兴奋的从里面窜出来，也像是得了什么宝贝。
但是，归他了！
男子来到奄奄一息的少年面前，抽出腰间的大刀，对着脖子劈了下去。在森林里生存，必须要心狠手辣，能杀则杀，别说任何废话。

嗡！
一道璀璨金光刹那绽放，如骄阳坠落山谷，熠熠夺目。
男子警惕性极高，刹那后退，然而那股绽放的强光竟瞬间化作一道五六米的金剑，闪烁着复杂灵纹，灵威浩荡，锐气呼啸，刹那斩破山谷，将男子拦腰斩断。
金剑符？
二品高级灵符！
怎么可能？
这孩子衣衫破烂，消瘦如猴，说是山野村民都有人信，怎么可能有这等强大灵符？
男子眼神里震惊，泛起浓浓的不甘。明明很谨慎了，秉着搏兔亦用全力准则，他往往出手就是杀招，结果……特么的，二品高级灵符啊，杀个我，至于吗！
“这灵符这么强吗？”
周元看着如满月般绽放的璀璨剑芒，震惊又是惋惜。
这么强的灵符就这么用了？
还好，保命了。
也算物尽其用。
周元挣扎着撑起身子，胸腹翻涌，一阵剧烈咳嗽后，嘴里溢出血水。刚刚那股血雾太强了，如果不是雷灵之气淬炼了体魄，怕是五脏六腑都被活活震碎。
灵修世界果然神奇，竟然还有这种霸道的灵法。
周元缓了缓，来到了被斩杀的男子身旁。
这人又阴又狠，不是善茬，应该能攒不少好东西。
既然死了，就别浪费了。
content_en:
Second Austrian!
Zhou Yuan broke out in a cold sweat. If he had reacted a little slower, this bloody light might have penetrated his chest and killed him on the spot.
Where did the animals appear and kill them without saying hello?
Thunder light flashed around Zhou Yuan, bursting out in an instant and rushing towards the hillside ahead. But the moment he stood up, a majestic figure from Taniguchi had already rushed in, and slapped the ground hard with his palm.
boom!
The ground roared, the valley trembled, and a majestic blood mist exploded, like a mad tide, sweeping across the valley and flooding Zhou Yuan.
"Roar..."
There seemed to be an evil beast roaring in the blood mist, and it hit Zhou Yuan hard.
Zhou Yuan felt an irresistible force coming towards him. His whole body trembled, and he flew away from the ground. After landing, he continued to tumble. It felt like his internal organs were all out of place, and he opened his mouth to spurt out a stream of blood.
What kind of magic is this?
It can actually shock the blood!
Zhou Yuan struggled a few times and fell to the ground. His weak body could not withstand such a violent impact. He raised his head with difficulty, and in his blurry vision, a tall and burly man with a broad chest was walking out of the blood mist.
"Earth Scale Python...Thunder Winged Eagle...are all first level peak monsters."
The man clicked his tongue in amazement. This was the outskirts of the Yunwu Mountains. Common monsters were rare, but there were actually first-level peaks, and there were two of them.
What's even more incredible is that they died together.
This is a rare adventure.
The man looked at the cave in the corner. There might be some secret hidden in it, so he attracted these two peak-level monsters and even beat them to death.
And this kid just jumped out of it with a face full of excitement, as if he had got some kind of treasure.
But it belongs to him!
The man came to the dying young man, drew out the sword from his waist, and slashed it into the neck. To survive in the forest, you must be ruthless, kill if you can, and don't talk nonsense.
Buzz!
A bright golden light bloomed instantly, shining like a scorching sun falling into a valley.
The man was extremely vigilant and retreated in an instant. However, the bright light suddenly turned into a five- to six-meter golden sword, flashing with complex spiritual patterns. The spiritual power was mighty and the sharp energy roared. It cut through the valley in an instant and cut the man in half.
Golden sword talisman?
Second-grade high-level talisman!
How is that possible?
This child's clothes are in tatters and he is as skinny as a monkey. Even the villagers in the mountains believe him. How could he have such a powerful talisman?
The man's eyes were shocked and filled with deep unwillingness. He was obviously very cautious, and adhered to the principle of using all his strength to fight the rabbit. He often used his killing move, but the result... What the hell, a second-grade high-level spiritual talisman, kill me, what's the matter!
"Is this talisman so powerful?"
Zhou Yuan looked at the dazzling sword light blooming like a full moon, shocked and regretful at the same time.
Is such a powerful talisman used like this?
Fortunately, my life was saved.
It can also be considered as making the best use of everything.
Zhou Yuan struggled to hold himself up, his chest and abdomen swelled, and after a violent cough, blood overflowed from his mouth. The blood mist just now was so strong that if it weren't for the thunder spirit energy that tempered the body, all the internal organs would have been shattered alive.
The spiritual world is really magical, and there is such a domineering spiritual method.
Zhou Yuan slowed down and came to the side of the beheaded man.
This man is sinister and ruthless. He is not a good person. He should be able to save a lot of good things.
Now that it's dead, don't waste it.
